title: Multidimensional convolution matrices and perfect colorings of subspace hypergraphs applied for bent functions and related designs
summary: The main aim of the present paper is to introduce new methods for the study of combinatorial designs related to bent functions. They are based on interpretations of convolution on finite abelian groups as multiplication by a multidimensional matrix and designs as perfect colorings of subspace hypergraphs of $\mathbb{F}_2^n$.
